rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the noun is identifiable, a particular instance is intended, or one option is being singled out, as in 嗰本書.

example.english: I want to read the book.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 tai2 go2 bun2 syu1

rows.meaning: definite article: body part or kin term
rows.note: Use this possessive construction for body parts, relatives, and pets when English uses “the” instead of an explicit possessive, as in 佢個頭.

example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 haa5 keoi5 go3 tau4

rows.note: Use this for the superlative slice of these senses, before an overt noun or alone when the noun is understood, as in 最好嗰個.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 zeoi3 hou2 go2 go3

rows.note: Use this for the ordinal slice of these senses, before an overt noun or alone when the noun is understood, as in 第一個.

example.english: I was the first person to arrive.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 dai6 jat1 go3 dou3 ge3
